desc: The Timney Enhanced Feel Trigger Shoe answers the call for a trigger shoe that enhances the overall feel of the trigger break by making the trigger feel more comfortable and predictable. The Timney Trigger Shoe matches the historic reliability of the Glock system by providing an improved trigger feel that does not sacrifice Glock’s integrity. With added benefits, such as an adjustable safety take-up (movement), the Timney Enhanced Trigger Feel Shoe allows the user to become more accurate with their pistol.
